title: Say 'I Got This' Under Panic, Watch Your Brain Spiral Faster
description:
Documentary case briefing on Why Silently Using Your Own First Name Quiets Your Amygdala in 1 Second, grounded in ['Jason S. Moser' (2017) (Scientific Reports). Empirical findings show that in Ethan Kross's 2014 Trier Social Stress Test experiments, volunteers received just 2 minutes to prepare a 5-minute job speech before stone-faced evaluators and a video camera.

At the circuit level, this episode examines how amygdala, prefrontal cortex, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex coordinate behavioral and neural responses, alongside evidence that participants instructed to coach themselves silently using their own first name and 'you' felt less threat and delivered significantly stronger speeches rated by blind evaluators than participants using 'I'.
